title: Calibrated Stereo Pinhole Projection, DLT Triangulation, and Trajectory Error Analysis
objective: Standardized evaluation of binocular pinhole cameras, Direct Linear Transformation (DLT) 3D triangulation, reprojection RMSE, and Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE)
hypothesis: Calibrated stereo triangulation using SVD Direct Linear Transformation achieves sub-pixel reprojection error (RMSE <= 0.5 px) and sub-meter visual odometry drift (ATE <= 0.20 m) across variable baseline configurations

dataset.name: KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite - Stereo / Odometry
dataset.sensorProvenance: Calibrated dual Point Grey Flea 2 stereo rig (baseline 0.54m, focal length 718.8px)
dataset.citation: Geiger et al., Are we ready for Autonomous Driving? The KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite, CVPR 2012

knownLimitations: Stereo depth uncertainty increases quadratically with scene depth: sigma_Z = (Z^2 / (f * B)) * sigma_d, limiting depth fidelity for far-field objects (>50m).
author: Tim Riset Visi Komputer ITERA
